name: @petercjl/tuda
description: CLI for Tuda: images, videos, and creative workflows on one canvas. Generate, edit, organize, and export with your configured models.

scripts.build: node scripts/sync-skill.mjs && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/main.js && esbuild src/board-plugin.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/board-plugin.js --metafile=dist/board-plugin.meta.json && node scripts/build-plugin-notices.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && node scripts/sync-skill.mjs && npm run build
